d:
Amazon has announced another round of layoffs, cutting around 250 positions in its Devices and Services division, which works on products like Kindle, Alexa and Echo. The latest job cuts come after reports of around 1,000 job reductions in Amazon’s retail business earlier in October 2026.
Over the past year, Amazon has announced cuts affecting more than 31,000 positions across different rounds of layoffs. But why is one of the world’s biggest tech companies repeatedly reducing its workforce? Is Amazon facing financial trouble, or is it changing the way it operates?
